data.content_ref: inline:The target's core mechanism relies on the model performing 'gradient descent in semantic space' via in-context learning from rejected outputs. However, standard LLMs do not update their weights or internal probability distributions based on context window content; they only condition generation on tokens. The claim that the model 'shifts its probability distribution toward regions... that satisfy constraints' conflates static inference-time conditioning with dynamic optimization (learning), rendering the proposed mechanism scientifically invalid for non-training models.
